blocked.name: Sink into Stupor // Soporific Springs
blocked.why: "Return target spell or nonland permanent an opponent controls": no target spec spans the stack and the battlefield in one slot.

blocked.name: Selvala, Heart of the Wilds
blocked.why: "X mana in any combination of colors" is always activated by hand (its {G} cost keeps it off the auto-payer), and by hand past X = 4 across five colours only all-of-one-colour is offered, so the split isn't the player's.

blocked.name: Maskwood Nexus
blocked.why: Creature spells you control and creature cards you own outside the battlefield are every creature type too; a static's types reach only the battlefield.

blocked.name: Curse of Opulence
blocked.why: An Aura that enchants a player, and 'whenever enchanted player is attacked'.

blocked.name: Springheart Nantuko
blocked.why: Bestow isn't modeled (AUTHORING §15).

blocked.name: Mirari's Wake
blocked.why: "One mana of any type that land produced": a land tapped by hand for two types at once (a Karoo) gets the first type, not the player's pick; the auto-payer does offer each.

blocked.name: Life from the Loam
blocked.why: Dredge 3.

blocked.name: Archaeomancer's Map
blocked.why: "If that player controls more lands than you": opponent-controls-more asks about any opponent, not the one whose land entered.

blocked.name: Fact or Fiction
blocked.why: An opponent separates the revealed cards into two piles, and you choose one.

blocked.name: Starting Town
blocked.why: "Unless it's your first, second, or third turn of the game": no per-player count of turns taken.

blocked.name: Narset's Reversal
blocked.why: "You may choose new targets for the copy."

blocked.name: Forbidden Orchard
blocked.why: "Whenever you tap this land for mana, target opponent creates a Spirit" is a targeted trigger that uses the stack; a tapped-for-mana trigger is only ever a triggered mana ability's add-mana.

blocked.name: Mockingbird
blocked.why: Enter as a copy of a creature with mana value at most the mana spent, except a Bird with flying; copyOnEnter takes no filter and no exceptions.

blocked.name: Drannith Magistrate
blocked.why: "Can't cast spells from anywhere other than their hands": a static prohibition's spell filter can't ask which zone the card is cast from.

blocked.name: Flare of Fortitude
blocked.why: "Until end of turn, your life total can't change."

blocked.name: Kenrith's Transformation
blocked.why: The enchanted creature loses all abilities and is a green 3/3 Elk (only): a static can add types but not set types or colour, or remove abilities.

blocked.name: Champion's Helm
blocked.why: "As long as equipped creature is legendary, it has hexproof": no static condition asks about the permanent an Equipment is attached to.

blocked.name: Leyline of Anticipation
blocked.why: Beginning the game with it on the battlefield from the opening hand.

blocked.name: Elvish Spirit Guide
blocked.why: "Exile this card from your hand: Add {G}" is a mana ability from the hand; zone abilities are never mana abilities.

blocked.name: Hellkite Tyrant
blocked.why: "You win the game", and "gain control of all artifacts that player controls" — no filter clause names the damaged player.

blocked.name: Isochron Scepter
blocked.why: Imprint an instant from hand; cast a copy of it free as the ability resolves.

blocked.name: Chimil, the Inner Sun
blocked.why: Discover 5.

blocked.name: Imprisoned in the Moon
blocked.why: The enchanted permanent is a colorless land with "{T}: Add {C}" and loses all other card types and abilities: statics can't set types or colour, or remove abilities.

blocked.name: Collective Resistance
blocked.why: Escalate {G}: a cost for each mode beyond the first.

blocked.name: Brain Freeze
blocked.why: Storm's copies "may choose new targets".

blocked.name: Spinerock Knoll
blocked.why: Hideaway 4 (AUTHORING §15).

blocked.name: Inkshield
blocked.why: A spell's prevention of all combat damage to you this turn, making a token for each 1 damage prevented.

blocked.name: Peregrin Took
blocked.why: "Those tokens plus an additional Food", and "Sacrifice three Foods" as a cost.

blocked.name: Liliana, Dreadhorde General
blocked.why: −9: each opponent keeps one permanent of each permanent type (a multi-typed one counting for any) and sacrifices the rest.

blocked.name: High Tide

blocked.name: Mizzix's Mastery

blocked.name: Cankerbloom
blocked.why: A modal activated ability whose modes target.

blocked.name: Colossus Hammer
blocked.why: "Equipped creature … loses flying": a static can grant keywords but not remove one.

blocked.name: Aurelia, the Warleader

blocked.name: Sai, Master Thopterist
blocked.why: "Sacrifice two artifacts" as an activation cost.

blocked.name: Wonder
blocked.why: "As long as this card is in your graveyard and you control an Island": statics work only from the battlefield.

blocked.name: Yawgmoth, Thran Physician
blocked.why: "{B}{B}, Discard a card: Proliferate" — discard as an activation cost.

blocked.name: The Mycosynth Gardens
blocked.why: "This land becomes a copy of target nontoken artifact you control with mana value X."

blocked.name: Bloodletter of Aclazotz
blocked.why: "If an opponent would lose life during your turn, they lose twice that much": no life-loss replacement.

blocked.name: Tainted Pact
blocked.why: Exile until you keep a card or exile two with the same name.

blocked.name: Boromir, Warden of the Tower
blocked.why: "The Ring tempts you" isn't modeled.

blocked.name: Beseech the Mirror
blocked.why: Bargain, and casting the found card free as it resolves.

blocked.name: Breach the Multiverse

blocked.name: Tempt with Discovery
blocked.why: Tempting offer: the opponents who accept all search at the same time after everyone has decided (the ruling), then you search once per acceptor; each-player-may performs each acceptance as it's answered.

blocked.name: Buster Sword
blocked.why: Casting a spell from hand free as the trigger resolves.

blocked.name: Expressive Iteration
blocked.why: Of the three cards: one to hand, one to the bottom, one exiled and playable this turn.

blocked.name: Thousand-Year Elixir
blocked.why: "Activate abilities of creatures you control as though those creatures had haste."

blocked.name: Bear Umbra
blocked.why: Umbra armor (totem armor).

blocked.name: Throne of Eldraine
blocked.why: "Spend only mana of the chosen color to activate this ability", and mana for monocolored spells of that colour.

blocked.name: Solphim, Mayhem Dominus
blocked.why: "Discard two cards" as an activation cost.

blocked.name: Nature's Rhythm
blocked.why: Harmonize (cast from the graveyard, tapping a creature to reduce the cost).

blocked.name: Grim Hireling
blocked.why: "Sacrifice X Treasures" as a cost.

blocked.name: Demonic Consultation

blocked.name: Xorn
blocked.why: "Those tokens plus an additional Treasure token."

blocked.name: Reconnaissance
blocked.why: Remove target attacking creature from combat.

blocked.name: Sword of Hearth and Home
blocked.why: The exiled creature and the found basic land enter together; a flicker and a search are two entries.

blocked.name: Field of Ruin
blocked.why: "Each player searches their library for a basic land card" — a search by every player, not optional.

blocked.name: Archway of Innovation

blocked.name: Ripples of Potential
blocked.why: Phasing.

blocked.why: "Whenever a land's ability causes you to add mana of the chosen color": any land mana ability, not just a {T} one, filtered by a chosen colour.

blocked.name: Kappa Cannoneer
blocked.why: Improvise.

blocked.name: Promise of Loyalty
blocked.why: Each player keeps a creature of their choice with a vow counter and sacrifices the rest; the vow's attack restriction.

blocked.why: "You gain twice that much life instead": would-gain-life adds, never multiplies.

blocked.why: +1/+1 for each other creature sharing a creature type with each creature.

blocked.name: Desperate Ritual
blocked.why: Splice onto Arcane.

blocked.name: Sejiri Shelter // Sejiri Glacier
blocked.why: "Protection from the color of your choice."

blocked.why: "This creature is the chosen type in addition to its other types" (AUTHORING §15).
